about: Every character the world draws besides Zhusha, until its 128 px art exists (Dex 10-18: "white placeholder boxes at player height"): a plain white box standing at her drawn height (zhusha/feel.json charScale), drawn by src/tesu/cast/npcs.ts in place of the world sprite with the same id. w = the box's width in her drawn heights (people: her own box's 0.36). who = the cast folder its art slots into, public/assets/cast/<who>/<slot>/, through the same sprite contract as hers (128 px, lanes/anim/SPRITE-CONTRACT.md); roles = which slot each of the sprite's frames plays ("*" for every frame not listed); with no slot the box stays. poses = an optional squash (sx, sy) or lean per frame so what the code drives still reads (the Lion's wind-up before its pounce). Left as drawn (not cast, or not at her scale): the hall cat, the paper spectators in the court's stands (back plane), the Walker (its own lane).

champion.name: the Lion, dexClient's champion (to become a dragon)

hanko.name: Hanko, at the front desk (her anchor is the desk top)
